profile.headline: Lead Front-end Engineer at Manheim
profile.summary:
I am a passionate and dedicated professional that's been building for the web since 2000 with experience in User Interface Engineering, Software Development and Design.

I have developed many applications that leverage AJAX and event driven object-oriented JavaScript. I worked in ActionScript 3 for a major sports content provider delivering high visibility sports streaming solutions. I have many years of experience working with jQuery.

I co-author an internal UI framework working closing with UX in order to deliver reusable and predictable patterns to accelerate the delivery of products for a major automotive company. 

I love the challenge of having to solve problems using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.  I have many years of experience using CSS Sass and have worked across a wide variety of stacks writing AngularJS, Angular and React. I am proficient using node and have experience using Hapi and Express. 

Most of my version control experience is in Git but I worked with SVN and CVS before as well. 

I have a strong passion for writing semantic and accessible web applications and have working experience creating 508-compliant web sites for the US government. -

I designed many sites using Photoshop and Fireworks. I have proven knowledge of image optimization for reduced bandwidth consumption.

Specialties: HTML/HTML5, CSS/CSS3/SASSCSS, Media Queries, JavaScript, jQuery, Angular, React, Git, Adaptive and Responsive Web Development, Touch, Mobile.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed applications for desktop and mobile using HTML5, CSS (SASS) and Javascript. Built a scalable and reusable Front-End framework to quickly stand up new applications. Languages and services used were HTML, SASS, Gulp, Ruby and Git.

positions.title: Advisory Front-end Engineer
positions.description: Developed applications for desktop and mobile using HTML5, CSS (SASS) and Javascript. Built a scalable and reusable Front-End framework to quickly stand up new applications. Languages and services used where HTML, SASS, Gulp, Ruby and Git.

positions.title: User Interface Engineer
positions.description: Worked cooperatively developing Simulcast on Mobile, an online auto auction system, as part of the existing Manheim Mobile App for iOS. Technologies used: HTML, CSS, Javascript with Responsive Web Development in mind.

positions.title: Front End Web Developer
positions.description:
Worked collaboratively in the development of the  Million Hearts Website, an initiative by the United States Health and Human Services to prevent 1 million heart attacks in the next 5 years. The front end project included developing an adaptive/responsive layout to cater to different devices (Desktop, iOS, Android) with different screen sizes leveraging technologies such as Modernizr, CSS Media Queries, OOJS and jQuery.

Built a section of the existing CDC iOS App as a hybrid app, called Disease of The Week entirely in HTML, Javascript, CSS using jQuery, iscroll (jQuery Plugin) and OOJS and OOCSS techniques.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed interactive applications including 2010 March Madness On Demand, Masters Live and overall video microsite development.

Contributed on CSS/grid framework and infrastructure across the site and implemented HTML5 features in multiple areas.
